scenario.environment: Shared HDB flat, kitchen and living area
scenario.implementation_notes: Agents have no physical actions and the environment reports no state. Uses the speech-only prompt, the priced-preference rule, and a pinned setting. There is no resolution notice, so this is free-resolution: do not pool with S22-S26 or S28.
scenario.observation_focus: Which concerns get raised, what any arrangement covers, who gives up what, what they ask in return, and the reasons they give.
scenario.shared_setting: Four adults have shared a rented HDB flat for eight months. There is one kitchen with one stove, a window, and a working extractor fan, and all four people cook there. The household has never agreed any rules about the kitchen. It is a weeknight evening and all four are in the kitchen and the living area next to it.
